services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: We're passionate about giving every camper a summer filled with adventure, friendship, and opportunities to grow in their faith. Camp naturally encourages kids to step outside their comfort zones, unplug from distractions, and discover the wonder of God's creation in a safe, supportive environment. Throughout the week, campers build meaningful, lasting friendships as they share daily activities, worship, and time together. Guided by caring staff, they dive into God's Word and learn what it means to grow in their relationship with Christ, with others, and with the world around them. blurb: Our unique camp welcomes children, students, adults, volunteers, and their families from all over the nation to experience God in fun-filled adventures on the journey to create disciples of Christ for the transformation of the world! Glen Lake Camp and Retreat Center is located in Glen Rose, Texas.
